name: Belmond Reid's Palace
insider_take: Perched dramatically on a cliff above the Atlantic, Reid's Palace has been Madeira's crown jewel since 1891 — a place where Churchill painted sunsets, and time gracefully slows to the rhythm of the waves below.
whats_special: Reid's Palace is one of Europe's most storied grand hotels, set on a private 10-acre clifftop estate overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Its legendary afternoon tea tradition, held on the terrace since the Victorian era, remains a beloved ritual. As part of the Belmond Bellini Club , members enjoy exclusive perks including priority reservations, onboard credits, and curated upgrades. The hotel's saltwater pools — carved directly into the volcanic cliffside — are nothing short of iconic, and the award-winning spa draws on local Madeiran botanicals for truly immersive treatments.
pro_tip: Book a Classic Ocean Room on an upper floor for unobstructed Atlantic views, and don't skip the sunset cocktails at the William Bar — named after founder William Reid himself. Bellini Club members should ask about complimentary room upgrades at check-in.
dont_miss: Madeira's unique levada walks are just minutes away — ancient irrigation channels that wind through lush laurisilva forest, a UNESCO World Heritage landscape. Back at the hotel, indulge in the legendary Afternoon Tea on the Main Terrace , a tradition dating back over 130 years. And be sure to sip a glass of the island's famed Madeira wine — some vintages served here are older than the hotel itself.
pros: Historic luxury palace dating back to 1891 with timeless elegance
Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Atlantic Ocean views
Exceptional service standards and refined hospitality
Beautiful subtropical gardens and terraced grounds
cons: Premium pricing reflecting luxury heritage status
Traditional formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
